expectations.text: Recommends the release-with-debug profile for profiling
expectations.evidence: Recommends adding debug=true to [profile.release] or a new [profile.profiling] — the right concept, but reinvents it instead of using the repo's existing release-with-debug profile.

expectations.text: Recommends samply (cross-platform/Windows) with flamegraph as alternative
expectations.evidence: Recommends samply plus Windows-specific options (Superluminal, WPA, PIX, RenderDoc).

expectations.text: Explains how to read a flamegraph (widest box = most CPU time)
expectations.evidence: Mentions flame graphs but never explains the x-axis = time / widest-box reading.

expectations.text: Diagnoses likely canvas-tool causes (dirty-rect, per-move clone, frame thread)
expectations.evidence: Names whole-buffer re-scan, full-texture re-upload, undo-path full-buffer clone, egui re-tessellation; recommends dirty-region bounding.

expectations.text: Does not jump straight to a code rewrite without profiling first
expectations.evidence: 'Why not just start optimizing' section; measure-first ordered plan.
